Fulham Boss Arbeloa Previews Premier League Clash vs Aston Villa

04 Nov 2026, 02:18 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.bbc.com

2 min read

Key takeaways

Match Overview

  • Competition: Premier League
  • Teams: Fulham vs Aston Villa
  • Venue: Villa Park, Birmingham
  • Date & Time: Saturday, 20:00 GMT
  • Format: 90‑minute league fixture
  • Result: Not yet played – scheduled

Key Updates from Arbeloa

  • Injury News: No new injuries reported after Fulham’s EFL Cup defeat to Crystal Palace.
  • Performance Review: Arbeloa said his side “did well enough to win” but acknowledged room for improvement in the final third, noting they “could have created more chances.”
  • Antonee Robinson: The defender will start the weekend match. Arbeloa praised his importance and described his performance as “very good,” while urging the squad to focus on the next game.
  • Emile Smith Rowe: The midfielder, who has limited minutes, is “waiting for his opportunity.” Arbeloa explained that a recent injury against Hull and squad depth have kept him out, adding that Smith Rowe “needs to come here every day and give his best.”
  • Managing in England: In his first three months as Fulham boss, Arbeloa called the challenge “very tough” but expressed happiness, saying he enjoys his days and wants to win games while noting the need for improvement.
  • Aston Villa Analysis: He described Villa as “very compact” with strong defending and good ball control. He highlighted the quality of their players and praised head coach Unai Emery as “one of the best coaches in the world,” noting the challenge of facing him.
  • Unai Emery: Arbeloa called the fellow Spaniard “one of the best coaches in their country's history” and added that Emery “improves everything every year” regardless of his club.

How to Verify

  • The information comes from Arbeloa’s press conference held on Friday, as reported by the BBC Sport website.

Practical Implications

  • Fulham will be without any newly reported injured players, suggesting a full squad availability for the match.
  • The focus on finishing and creating more chances indicates possible tactical adjustments for the upcoming fixture.
  • Robinson’s guaranteed start underscores his key role in Fulham’s defensive setup.
